items.title: 14.8.1 Factors affecting air quality (air quality par asar dalne wale factors) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.8.1, printed pages 314-315.

blocks.text: Air quality par kai important factors ya sources asar dalte hain.
i) Emission sources (pollution nikalne ki jagahein)

Lakri aur fossil fuels jalane se local (maqami) pollution barhti hai. Factories aur power plants fossil fuels istemal karte hain jo hawa mein SOₓ aur NOₓ jaise khatarnak pollutants chhorte hain. Gariyan CO, PM aur VOCs chhorti hain.

Wind (hawa), temperature aur humidity (nami) is baat par asar dalte hain ke pollutants kitna disperse (phailte) hain aur kitne ikatthe rehte hain. Agar garam hawa ki ek layer pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb qaid kar le (inversion) to air quality kharab ho jati hai.
iv) Natural events (qudrat ki taraf se)
Wild fires (jangal ki aag) atmosphere mein bohat sa dhuan aur PM chhor sakti hai. Natural dust storms (dhool ke toofan) air quality ko bohat gira sakte hain.
Temperature ka badalna, jaise different mausamon mein buildings ko garam ya thanda karna, pollutants ka emission barha sakta hai. Seasonal pollen ki zyada amount bhi air quality kharab kar sakti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab mein factors ki numbering i, ii, iv, v chhapi hai (iii nahi hai); yahan bhi kitab wali numbering rakhi gai hai. Factors total chaar hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa natural factor air quality ko behtar kar sakta hai? Aur AQI 51 se 100 kis level ko dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Rainfall (barish) particles aur ghulne wali gases ko hawa se dho kar air quality behtar karti hai. AQI 51 se 100 'Moderate' (darmiyana, peela rang) hai.

items: Factors: emission sources; meteorological conditions (hawa, temperature, nami, garam hawa ki layer); natural events (wild fires, dust storms); seasonal changes (garam/thanda karna, pollen).
